A custom data_as_elements list names the elements to convert

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"data_as_elements\":[\"section\"]}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<div><section data-as=\"p\">First</section><section data-as=\"p\">Second</section></div>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
